knowledge.title: Tracing is OpenTelemetry-based
knowledge.text: Arize tracing is built on OpenTelemetry. OpenInference provides OTel-based instrumentation and semantic conventions for LLM applications, and spans are exported over OTLP; a proprietary agent is not required to send traces. Instrumentation effort depends on the frameworks and services involved.
